results.title: Predictive Analytics: An Overview
results.content: Predictive analytics is the use of data, statistical algorithms, and machine learning techniques to identify the likelihood of future outcomes based on historical data. In digital twin environments, predictive analytics and machine learning techniques are used for predictive maintenance, identifying and mitigating potential threats, and recommending preventive actions such as software updates or network configuration changes to protect critical systems and data. In network optimization, predictive analytics capabilities built into digital twins use historical data and machine learning algorithms to forecast future behavior and enable proactive optimization, such as predicting traffic patterns for urban mobility and optimizing traffic flow. Predictive analytics models are constructed through steps including data collection, cleaning, feature selection, model selection, training, evaluation, and deployment, with common models including support vector machines, decision trees, logistic regression, random forests, and neural networks.
